rationale: New sourced local contract violation found while auditing the configuration/authority path, registered as an obligation with physical bindings. Evidence already retained: exploration check 86b51caa6a8141a9802f09aa24ea13af recorded CA_EVENT public_configuration_index where a committed AddNonvoter produced add_nonvoter_index 4, internal_config_index 4 but public_config_index 0, with index_reported_as_zero true and indexes_disagree true while public_servers and internal_servers were identical. Source: Raft.GetConfiguration builds its future from only the latest configuration value (api.go:895-903) and configurationsFuture.Index returns the index of that partial value (future.go:262-270).

question.question: Does Raft.GetConfiguration report the index of the latest configuration, and what do callers lose if it always reports zero?
question.importance: The configuration index is the identity a caller needs to use the prevIndex guard accepted by AddVoter, AddNonvoter, RemoveServer and DemoteVoter, and it is also reported by Stats as latest_configuration_index.
unknowns: Whether any in-tree caller or documented pattern relies on GetConfiguration().Index() for the prevIndex guard

obligation.description: Raft.GetConfiguration must report the index of the configuration it returns, so that a caller can use that index as the prevIndex guard accepted by the membership-change APIs and Stats can report the actual latest configuration index.

scope.description: Any call to Raft.GetConfiguration while a configuration is known to the node.
assumptions: ConfigurationFuture.Index is documented as the index of the latest configuration in use by Raft.
excluded: The internal configurationsCh path used by takeSnapshot, which does return the full value including the index

pending: Determine whether any in-tree caller depends on GetConfiguration().Index() for the prevIndex guard

grounding.derivation: GetConfiguration constructs its future with only the latest configuration value set (api.go:895-903), so the configurations struct's latestIndex stays zero, and configurationsFuture.Index returns exactly that field (future.go:262-270).
grounding.applicability: Applies whenever the public GetConfiguration future is read.
unresolved: Whether a deployment has relied on the zero value, which would make a populated index a behaviour change for it
alternatives: Treat the index field of the public future as intentionally unused for callers

bindings.description: Builds the public configuration future from only the latest configuration value, leaving the index unset.
Returns the index field of the stored configurations value, which GetConfiguration never populates.
